name: GDR low-temperature geothermal thermoelectric material measurements
description: Small experimental development release of p-type BiSbTe and n-type BiSeTe compacts, with separately tabulated module measurements.
count_scope: 6 p-type and 13 n-type table rows, including one earlier-work n-type reference; separate module rows excluded

sources.title: GDR692 primary release
sources.evidence: Three public files with Southern Research Institute/Novus provenance, DOE project EE0006746 and CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Released material workbook
sources.evidence: Independently counted 19 specimen IDs across two tables: 6 p-type BiSbTe and 13 n-type BiSeTe rows; units are embedded in headers.

sources.title: Released methods document
sources.evidence: Describes mechanical alloying/hot pressing, rectangular cut bars and ULVAC ZEM-3 resistivity/Seebeck testing; discusses precursor oxygen contamination.

caveats: Specimen rows are not distinct compositions or refined crystal structures; exact stoichiometries and atomic coordinates are absent.
Per-row measurement temperatures and uncertainty estimates are absent from the spreadsheet; this is a qualified small development study, not a thermoelectric reference compilation.
Several n-type entries exceed 100% theoretical density; retain reported values and investigate the density basis before modeling.
The separately released module workbook has 10 module rows and a resistance header labeled mW; do not silently reinterpret that unit or combine module and material counts.
No thermal conductivity or complete zT measurements are supplied in the inspected material table.

additional_counts.scope: Separate module workbook; includes one previous-work module; excluded from material specimen count
